text:
maya: Heads up — microburst on 16th & Bryant just dumped a lake on the sidewalk. Left the office with my shoes 100% saturated :scream: Caltrain's showing delays + single-track between 4:15–4:45p.
transit-bot: CALTRAIN ALERT: Service advisory: DELAY due to signal issue between 22nd St and San Jose. Expect +20-30m. https://caltrain.com/alerts
kevin: Ugh. Thanks — stuck on 22nd St platform now. No canopy and wind is fun.
sam: If anyone's near Mission/Bryant I have spare umbrellas in my trunk. Ping me.
alex: @maya did your bike survive? My chain rusted last week from the last monsoon :-/
maya: Bike okay but my messenger bag's a swimming pool. RIP lunch.
jamie: Muni bus on 14 stopped by flooded underpass at 3rd & Market, driver turned everyone around. Took an Uber instead.
commute-bot: BART STATUS: minor delays inbound SF due to slow zone at Embarcadero. ETA variance ~10 min.
kevin: Anyone commuting north? Thinking of switching to the ferry — how is that looking?
sam: Ferry reported smooth sailing, but lines at the ticket machines are long. Bring your Clipper or a card.
maya: Quick poll (shoe check): react with :thumbsup: if your shoes are wet, :thumbsdown: if dry.
alex: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup: (squish)
jamie: :thumbsdown: lucky me, dry socks today
sam: :thumbsdown: umbrella win.
maya: Thanks all — heading back to dry socks and tea. Carry-on tip: stash a ziplock for phone if you're biking! :coffee:
